MODEL 'MDL-HopperBlockageStimulus-1' HAS NOT BEEN VALIDATED AGAINST REAL PLANT DATA (M5), and its declaration names these absences: Any physical or process behaviour of a hopper. There is no material, no level dynamics, no in-flight mass, no sensor noise and no coupling whatsoever between the plant-running signal and the hopper-level signal: both are computed from Shape and elapsed time alone (N13, N14). Shape 2 holds the hopper high with the plant stopped indefinitely and nothing in the block forbids a physically impossible combination., An equipment-grounded model in the sense of spec S11 M2. The six shapes were fitted to the CASES THE SPECIFICATION AND VECTOR SET ASK FOR - the block's own comment says so ('six shapes cover every scenario the vector set asks for') - so the model inherits the register's assumptions and the register's blind spots are not represented by construction., The field-side signal path. Values are injected at the input buffer's test members (N21), so DI5_SHR_RunFwdFB and DI8_HPR_LevelHigh are bypassed entirely (FC_Inputs N1). No wire break, stuck-at, contact bounce, DI hardware input filtering or terminal polarity is represented., The REVERSE running feedback, or the plant-running condition as an OR of two directions. The model drives the forward feedback only and force-clears the reverse feedback's test member for the whole run (N22), while the monitored block's PlantRunning is Fwd OR Rev (FC_ControlMain line 92)., A coherent plant input image. DB_Input.Test[0] is the input map's SINGLE GLOBAL test-enable (FC_Inputs, every line), so while a run is under way EVERY member of DB_Input is taken from a Test bit - and only Test[5], Test[6] and Test[8] are written by anything in the corpus. The other nineteen read FALSE regardless of the field, so during a run the rest of the program (Control_Healthy, Cycle_Start/Stop, pusher limits, downstream running, motor fault, ...) sees an all-false input image. The model does not model those inputs; it suppresses them., A reset private to the monitored block. N21 writes the SHARED DB_Controls.FaultReset, which FC_ControlMain fans out to the shredder sequencer (line 23), the motor system (line 39), the pusher (line 59), the monitored block (line 93) and the physical output DQ11_SHR_FaultReset (line 84). It is a plain coil evaluated every scan of the run, so it also overwrites any externally written operator reset for the duration., A CPU stop, a CPU restart, or a power cycle. The block cannot command, cause, detect or confirm one. Nothing in it records that a restart occurred; the only thing it carries across is the single retentive Bool PreBoundaryDone (N10), which is set BEFORE any restart and says only that the pre-boundary phase completed., A HELD pre-boundary wait for that restart - CONTRADICTS THE BLOCK'S OWN COMMENTS. InPreBoundaryWait requires NOT PreBoundaryDone (N9) and N10 sets PreBoundaryDone from InPreBoundaryWait, so the wait state is true for EXACTLY ONE SCAN (~2 ms) and can never be waited in. On the next scan Offset flips from ClearDownTime to T#0S (N5), so ScenarioT jumps forward by 5 s (N6), and either (a) EndAt <= PreBoundaryHighRunning + 5 s, in which case N19 latches ScenarioDone immediately and N20 RESETS THE RETAINED PreBoundaryDone in the same scan - the boundary marker is destroyed and the run ends - or (b) EndAt is larger, in which case the model resumes driving the scenario from a clock already 5 s + PreBoundaryHighRunning into a timeline whose segments T1..T4 are measured from zero. The model has no mechanism to zero its own scenario clock at the boundary; only the CPU restart, which clears the non-retentive Running and RunTimer, can do that. Consequence: the Precondition = 1 path delivers its intended scenario only if the CPU is stopped within the same scan the pre-boundary phase ends, and delivers nothing usable otherwise., The monitored block's persistence threshold, or the instant it crosses it. ModelThreshold is a stimulus constant held as the instance start value T#60S (iDB_HopperBlockageStim) and is never read from the monitored block; ResetMode 3 places its pulse at the model's own number (N15, N16). If the block's preset differs, the pulse does not coincide with the block's crossing., Any observation, expectation or judgement of the monitored block. No network of this block reads any member of iDB_HopperBlockageMonitor; Armed and ScenarioDone are published, never compared against anything., The state the monitored block is actually in when a scenario starts. The clear-down drives the hopper low for 5 s and pulses the shared reset; whether that leaves the block unalarmed with a zeroed accumulator is the BLOCK'S behaviour, and this model neither establishes nor verifies it., Sub-scan timing. Every phase boundary is a comparison against the run timer's ET sampled once per OB1 scan (N2, N3), so commanded transitions land on scan boundaries and two commanded transitions less than one scan apart collapse. The narrowest reset the model can command is T#500MS inside the scenario (N4 ResetPulseWidth) and 1 s inside the clear-down (N4 ClearResetFrom/ClearResetUntil)., Runs longer than the run timer. RunTimer's PT is T#10M (N2) and a TON's ET stops at PT, so RunT saturates at ten minutes and every phase comparison freezes with it: a run whose clear-down plus EndAt exceeds that never reaches EndAt, never publishes ScenarioDone, and never ends., Validation of the commanded vector. Shape is Profile / 10 (N7); any Profile whose tens digit is not 1..5 - including 0, 6 and 7 or above - drives nothing at all and is indistinguishable in the driven signals from the deliberate idle shape 6. An unset or out-of-range command is a silent idle run, never a refusal., More than one hopper clear or more than one plant stop per run. Each shape yields at most one clear interval and at most one stop interval (N11, N12), so a second high episode after a re-accumulation, a second clear, or repeated stop/start within one scenario is not representable in a single run., An observation window that outlasts the scenario. Armed is ANDed with InScenario (N18), so an ArmUntil beyond EndAt is silently truncated at EndAt, and no ArmAt/ArmUntil window can open during the clear-down or the pre-boundary phase., A run containing no operator reset at all. Every run that starts with a clear-down asserts the commanded reset from 3 s to 4 s of the run irrespective of ResetMode (N16, N17); ResetMode 0 means 'no reset inside the scenario', not 'no reset in this run'. ResetMode 2 likewise presents exactly ONE rising edge of the commanded reset - the reset is false from 4 s to 5 s of the run and true from the first scan of the scenario - not zero edges..

caveats.Detail: THE ASSERTION FORM HAS NO AUTHORITY BEHIND IT. F-3 refuses a SAMPLED observation of a NEVER assertion, and the form is declared BY THE VECTOR — nothing checks it against the enumeration, because the enumeration still has no producer. So F-3 is enforced against what a vector CLAIMS, not against what the assertion IS, and an author who cites a NEVER and declares WHEN gets the permissive path.

DB-8 CANNOT DISTINGUISH 'SAW NOTHING' FROM 'NOTHING HAPPENED'. A sampled assertion that observed no disagreement is AssertionState.Held, identical to one that saw nothing because nothing occurred. F-3 prevents the case where that is dangerous (a NEVER assertion); it does not fix the package. This submission declares 17 sampled expectation(s) of 29.
